steps.title: In the ground
steps.text: Nickel comes in two kinds of deposit. Laterite is red tropical soil where weathering has concentrated nickel near the surface: Indonesia, the Philippines, New Caledonia. Sulphide ore lies deep in old igneous rock: Russia, Canada, Australia. Laterites hold 54% of known resources, sulphides 35%.
steps.india: Most of India's 189 Mt nickel resource sits in the overburden of the Sukinda chromite mines in Odisha.

steps.title: Mine
steps.text: Laterite is stripped from the surface with excavators, a few metres at a time, and trucked or barged to the plant. Sulphide ore is mined underground, crushed and floated into a concentrate.

steps.title: Smelt or leach
steps.text: Three routes. Rich laterite is melted in an electric furnace into nickel pig iron for stainless steel. Lean laterite is leached with acid under pressure, giving a mixed hydroxide for batteries. Sulphide concentrate is smelted to matte, as copper is.
out: Cobalt, from laterite leaching and sulphide refining
steps.india: Indonesia leads the growth in all three routes.

steps.title: Refine
steps.text: Matte and mixed hydroxide are dissolved and purified by solvent extraction. The solution is plated as pure nickel metal or crystallised as nickel sulphate, the battery chemical.
steps.india: Nicomet refines about 6,000 t/yr of imported feed.

steps.title: Make
steps.text: Most nickel is melted with iron and chromium into stainless steel. Sulphate is co-precipitated with cobalt and manganese into battery precursor, where China has more than 95% of capacity. Metal goes into superalloys and plating.
steps.india: Stainless steel makers run on imported nickel.

steps.title: Use
steps.text: Stainless steel takes most of the world's nickel: kitchens, chemical plants, buildings, rail coaches. Batteries are the fastest-growing use. Jet engines and gas turbines need nickel superalloys.
steps.india: Stainless steel is the main use.

steps.title: Recycle
steps.text: Stainless steel scrap goes straight back into the furnace with its nickel, which makes nickel one of the most recycled metals. Battery black mass is a newer source.

sources.title: Takshashila, India Critical Minerals: scores, project records and capability notes (2026)
